name: @troubastack/studio
description: TroubaStudio — the canonical TroubaStack editor SPA (I10). Builds to static assets embedded & served by core (I14). Embedded by the mobile app in a webview.

scripts.//build: Vite build → static SPA in dist/, which core embeds via embed.FS (I10, I14).
